text:
tara: Heads up — saw a weird billing spike on prod around 02:14 UTC. Looks like a streaming reconnect that did a tool call mid-stream and then got truncated. Console shows a provisional credit on route="latency-fast" but ledger later attributes to route="small-model-fallback". Noticed customer complaining about double-looking charge in their invoice.

jonathan: Do we have an example session id? any traces?

tara: session 7b4f2c. I pulled a quick event flow: client -> latency-fast (stream start) -> toolcall to search -> connection reset -> reconnect routed to small-model-fallback -> partial stream truncated and final tokens emitted. The provisional meter event had route=latency-fast but finalization event didn't carry original_route.

kevin: That sounds like our canonical problem: retry/fallback path drops route provenance when we serialize the truncation/final-charge event. When a toolcall fires we snapshot KV and later we only attach current route. If the final accounting only sees fallback route we move the charge.

maya: Minimal UX idea: show charges in console as "Provisional (pending finalization)" and then tag them finalized after reconciliation window. That reduces customer confusion while we fix attribution. Also show a receipt_id that links provisional->final.

samir: Agree on UX, but careful — if we leave provisional visible and then later finalize to a different route we risk customers thinking they were double-billed. We need strong dashboard language and an audit trail showing both provisional and adjustment entries.

kevin: Implementation thought: include a route_hint & origin_receipt fields in the provisional metering event and propagate them into any reconcile/finalize events. e.g. add to metering proto: 

```
{
  "metering_event": {
    "receipt_id": "rcpt_7b4f2c",
    "session_id": "7b4f2c",
    "route": "latency-fast",
    "route_hint": "latency-fast",    // persists across reconnects
    "toolcall": true,
    "provisional": true
  }
}
```

Then when finalizing: 

```
{
  "receipt_id": "rcpt_7b4f2c",
  "finalized": true,
  "final_route": "small-model-fallback",
  "origin_route_hint": "latency-fast",
  "adjustment": -12  // token delta if we move charge
}
```

jonathan: That would let billing reconcile and console show both entries and link them via receipt_id. Does it create extra work for ledger? we already have reconciliation jobs but they assume idempotent single-event flows.

samir: Ledger changes minimal if we emit adjustment events referencing receipt_id. The harder bit is wallet UI and export CSV; need to include adjustment rows. I'll sync with finance about presentation.

maya: For rollout UX, let's gate console change behind an opt-in feature flag and include a tooltip: "Provisional charges reflect in-progress streaming sessions and may be adjusted after reconciliation." Also expose a console filter for "provisional" vs "finalized".

kevin: Dev plan: 1) runtime: attach route_hint to provisional metering (kevin) 2) router: ensure reconnect preserves origin_receipt (jonathan) 3) billing: emit adjustment events (samir) 4) console: provisional/finalized UI + receipt link (maya).

tara: thanks — can we prioritize this for next sprint? customer impact looks medium but confusing. I'll file the umbrella bug and include the session log + sample events.

deploy-bot: Recorded incident ticket: #INC-2026-482, assigned to kevin, jonathan, samir, maya.

jonathan: I'll add unit tests for route_hint propagation and an integration test that simulates toolcall+reconnect+truncate.

kevin: One more edge: what if a reconnect goes to a higher-cost model (not fallback) and then we charge up rather than down? adjustment sign needs to be explicit. We'll normalize to a positive/negative token delta and always present net effect.

samir: Good point. Also log the provenance into telemetry so we can build an "attribution drift" dashboard (route origin vs final route over time). That will help us tune routing policy.

maya: i'll mock a quick UI wireframe and post in #eng-platform-design.

tara: sweet. action items summarised in the ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
